meta.title: Jyotish: free Vedic astrology charts
meta.description: Accurate Vedic birth charts (Kundli), Vimshottari Dasha, transits, Panchang and matching, in English, Hindi and Marathi.

footer.tagline: Free and open source Vedic astrology. Calculations use the Swiss Ephemeris with Lahiri ayanamsa.

common.forbidden: You do not have access to this page.

home.title: Your Vedic birth chart, calculated accurately
home.lead: Make a Kundli in seconds, see your Dasha periods and today's transits, and read what the classical rules say. Free, in English, Hindi and Marathi.
home.free: Free for everyone. No ads. Your birth details are encrypted.

accuracy.title: Checked for accuracy
accuracy.text: Planet positions come from the Swiss Ephemeris and are tested against independent references to within one arc second.

charts.title: North and South Indian charts
charts.text: Rasi, Navamsa and all sixteen divisional charts, in the style you are used to.

dasha.title: Vimshottari Dasha
dasha.text: Mahadasha, Antardasha and Pratyantardasha with exact dates, and which period you are in now.

readings.title: Classical readings
readings.text: Yogas and doshas found by clear rules, each with its classical source.

languages.title: Your language

consent.title: Before we start
consent.intro: To calculate charts we need to store birth details. Please read how we handle them.
consent.p1: We store the name, birth date, time and place you enter, only to calculate and show your charts.
consent.p2: Birth details are encrypted. Our staff cannot see them without a logged reason.
consent.p3: We never sell your data or show ads.
consent.p4: You can download or delete all your data from Settings at any time.
consent.checkbox: I agree that my birth details are stored to calculate charts.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draft: Draft: this text will be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.

what.p: Your email address and name, and the birth details you enter for each chart: name, date, time, place and gender if you give it. We also keep basic logs to keep the service safe.

why.p: Only to calculate and show charts, send the emails you ask for, and keep the service secure. We do not sell data or show ads.

where.p: On servers in India (Mumbai). Birth details are encrypted at rest.

who.p: Only you. Support staff can open birth details only with a written reason, and every such access is logged.

keep.p: Until you delete it. PDF reports are deleted automatically after 30 days.

rights.p: You can download all your data or delete your account from Settings at any time.

contact.p: Write to the project maintainers through the source code repository.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.draft: Draft: this text will be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.

service.p: Jyotish calculates Vedic astrology charts and shows classical interpretations. It is free to use.

advice.p: Astrology readings are for personal interest. Do not use them in place of medical, legal, financial or other professional advice.

accounts.p: Keep your email account safe, since it is how you sign in. Do not enter details of other people without their permission.

license.p: The source code is published under the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3.

changes.p: We may update these terms. We will tell you about important changes by email.

glossary.rasi: The birth chart (D1): the zodiac sign each planet was in at birth.
glossary.navamsa: The ninth divisional chart (D9), used for marriage and the strength of planets.
glossary.varga: A divisional chart: each sign is split into parts to study one area of life.
glossary.house: One of twelve parts of the chart, each about an area of life, counted from the Lagna.
glossary.nakshatra: One of 27 lunar mansions, each 13°20′ of the zodiac.
glossary.dignity: How comfortable a planet is in its sign: exalted, own, friendly, neutral, enemy or debilitated.
glossary.retrograde: The planet appears to move backwards as seen from Earth.
glossary.combust: The planet is very close to the Sun and is weakened.
glossary.vimshottari: A 120-year cycle of planetary periods, starting from the Moon's Nakshatra at birth.
glossary.sadeSati: The seven and a half years when Saturn moves through the signs before, on and after your Moon sign.
glossary.panchang: The five limbs of the Hindu calendar day: Tithi, Vara, Nakshatra, Yoga and Karana.
glossary.tithi: A lunar day: each 12° the Moon gains on the Sun.
glossary.yoga: A Panchang Yoga: each 13°20′ of the Sun and Moon's combined longitude.
glossary.ashtakoota: The eight-part (36 point) compatibility check used for marriage matching.
glossary.manglik: Mars in house 1, 2, 4, 7, 8 or 12 from the Lagna or Moon.
glossary.shadbala: The six-fold strength of a planet, measured in rupas.
glossary.ashtakavarga: Points each sign gets from the planets and Lagna, used to judge transits.
